sections.Profile:
"Sure Shot," released by Gottlieb in March 1976, is a single-player electro-mechanical game with a billiards theme, designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison; its add-a-ball version, "Bank Shot," came out the same month, and both light a rack of 15 numbered pool balls in the center of the playfield toward the end-of-ball bonus.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wedgehead, Pool (Billiards), Original Theme, 1970s
